title: Patient-Provider Dispute Figures — Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
The federal No Surprises Act patient-provider dispute process carries the same figures on every Good Faith & Price Estimates type: a 400.00 USD threshold, a 120 calendar-day initiation window counted from the date on the initial bill, and a 25.00 USD administrative fee paid to the selected dispute resolution entity.

| Estimate type | Threshold by which billed charges must exceed expected charges (USD) | Initiation window (calendar days from the date on the initial bill) | Administrative fee (USD) | Amount due further reduced by the fee when the determination is below billed charges | Billed amount kept out of collections, statements stop escalating while pending | Coverage answers eligible | Riverbend billed charges compared as | Billing-hold reason on the linked hospital account |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Single Scheduled Service | 400.00 | 120 | 25.00 | yes | yes | uninsured; self-pay elected | self-pay final bill less the uninsured discount | good faith estimate dispute pending |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Procedure with Co-Providers | 400.00 | 120 | 25.00 | yes | yes | uninsured; self-pay elected | self-pay final bill less the uninsured discount | good faith estimate dispute pending |
| Self-Pay Good Faith Estimate - Recurring Course of Care | 400.00 | 120 | 25.00 | yes | yes | uninsured; self-pay elected | self-pay final bill less the uninsured discount | good faith estimate dispute pending |
| Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate | 400.00 | 120 | 25.00 | yes | yes | uninsured; self-pay elected | self-pay final bill less the uninsured discount | good faith estimate dispute pending |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Imaging & Diagnostics | 400.00 | 120 | 25.00 | yes | yes | uninsured; self-pay elected | self-pay final bill less the uninsured discount | good faith estimate dispute pending |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery | 400.00 | 120 | 25.00 | yes | yes | uninsured; self-pay elected | self-pay final bill less the uninsured discount | good faith estimate dispute pending |
| Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery | 400.00 | 120 | 25.00 | yes | yes | uninsured; self-pay elected | self-pay final bill less the uninsured discount | good faith estimate dispute pending |

## Points of reading

- The insured coverage answer is not among the eligible coverage answers on any type.
- The figures do not vary by estimate type; what differs between types is only whether the patient's coverage answer is one of the eligible answers.
